footer.legal: © {{year}} {{studio_name}}. Designs, images and 3D models are for private viewing only. Indicative prices include GST and may change with the gold rate.

access_gate.title: A private viewing
access_gate.subline: Enter the code from your invitation to see the collection.
access_gate.code_hint: Six letters and numbers, as written in your invitation. Not case-sensitive.
access_gate.request_invitation_helper: The atelier will write to you, usually within a day.

errors.wrong_code: That code doesn't match an invitation. Check the letters and try again.
errors.expired_code: This code has expired. Ask the atelier for a fresh one, or request an invitation below.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries for now. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes, then try again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the atelier. Check your connection and try again.
errors.empty: Enter your access code to continue.

welcome.title: Wear it before it's made.
welcome.subline: See each piece on your own hand and ear, shape it to your taste, then talk it through with the atelier.
welcome.path_explore_helper: {{count}} pieces across Heirloom, Fine and Playful.
welcome.path_try_on_helper: Uses your camera. Nothing leaves this device.

collection.title: The collection
collection.intro: Every piece is made to order in the atelier. Try it on here, then make it yours.

intros.heirloom: Traditional motifs, made light enough to wear every day.
intros.fine: Quiet lines and single stones, for the days that ask for less.
intros.playful: Small pieces with a wink: stack them, mix them, lend them out.

collection.ar_badge_aria: Can be tried on with your camera

piece_detail.price_disclaimer: Indicative, including GST, at today's gold rate. Your final price is confirmed at consultation, once weight and stones are set.
piece_detail.complete_the_set_intro: Pieces drawn from the same motif.
piece_detail.share_copied: Link copied. It opens only with your access code.

viewer_3d.orbit_hint: Drag to turn. Pinch or scroll to look closer.
viewer_3d.orbit_hint_keyboard: Use the arrow keys to turn, plus and minus to look closer.
viewer_3d.ear_stand_caption: Shown as a pair beside the ear stand
viewer_3d.neck_stand_caption: Shown on the neck stand, at true length
viewer_3d.loading: Bringing the piece to the light…
viewer_3d.weight_by_metal_note: Weights are estimated from the design and may vary by a few tenths of a gram.

price_breakdown.heading: How the price is made
price_breakdown.rate_note: Gold value uses today's indicative 24K rate of {{gold_rate_24k}} per gram, adjusted for purity. It is not a quote.

camera_intro.title: Try it on
camera_intro.body: We'll use your camera to place the piece on you, live.
camera_intro.privacy_promise: Your camera stays on this device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

bracelet.step_1: Hold your wrist in view, palm down.
bracelet.done: That's it. Move as you like.

ring.choose_finger: Tap a finger to move the ring.

tops.step_1: Face the camera, then turn a little to one side.
tops.step_2: Tuck your hair behind your ear.

necklace.note: Necklaces are shown in 3D only for now. Try-on for necklaces is being made.

maang_tikka.note: Maang tikkas are shown in 3D only for now.

tracking.lost: We've lost you for a moment. Hold still.
tracking.light: A little more light would help.

rough_preview.explainer: A close impression, true to shape and colour; the final piece is made for you.

ar.camera_privacy: Your camera stays on this device. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

controls.switch_piece_aria: Choose another piece to try on

ar.snapshot_saved: Snapshot saved to your look board. It stays on this device.

customise.sheet_intro: Changes here go into your design brief. The atelier confirms each one with you.

metal_colour.label: Metal colour
metal_colour.helper: Yellow, white or rose. The shape stays the same.

karat.label: Karat
karat.helper: 22K is richer in colour and softer; 18K and 14K hold stones more firmly.

stones.label: Stones
stones.helper: Keep the stones as drawn, change them, or leave them out.
stones.placement_placeholder: Where would you like the stone?

length_size.helper_length: Measured end to end, clasp included.
length_size.helper_wrist: Measure your wrist snugly and we'll add the ease.
length_size.helper_ring: Not sure? Bring a ring you already wear to the consultation.

helpers.lighter: Slimmer walls and a hollow back, for everyday wear. Est. {{weight_low}}–{{weight_high}} g.
helpers.statement: A fuller profile with more presence. Est. {{weight_low}}–{{weight_high}} g.

notes.label: Notes for the atelier
notes.placeholder: A motif you love, an heirloom to rework, how you'll wear it…

look_board.title: Your look board
look_board.intro: The pieces you've saved and tried on, kept together for your consultation.
look_board.book_cta: Book a consultation with these looks
look_board.empty_body: Save a piece, or take a snapshot while trying on, and it will wait for you here.
look_board.stays_on_device: Your look board stays on this device until you book.

booking.title: Book a consultation
booking.intro: An unhurried conversation with the atelier about the pieces on your look board.

visit_type.label: How would you like to meet?
visit_type.in_studio_helper: At the atelier, {{studio_city}}. About 60 minutes, with the pieces in hand where we have them.
visit_type.video_call_helper: From wherever you are. About 45 minutes; we'll send a private link.

slots.header: Times in IST, the atelier's time
slots.none_this_day: No times left on this day. Try another date.

contact.name_placeholder: As you'd like us to address you
contact.phone_helper: With country code. We'll only use it about this consultation.
contact.email_helper: Your confirmation and design brief go here.

needed_by.label: Needed by
needed_by.helper: Most pieces take 4 to 6 weeks to make.

budget.label: Budget range
budget.helper: A range helps the atelier suggest what fits. It stays private.

consent.brief: Share my look board and changes with the atelier as a design brief.
consent.contact: The atelier may contact me about this consultation.
consent.updates: Send me occasional notes about new pieces. You can stop these at any time.
consent.privacy_note: Your details are shared only with {{studio_name}}. Try-on images never leave your device.

errors.visit_type_required: Choose how you'd like to meet.
errors.slot_required: Choose a time that suits you.
errors.slot_taken: Someone has just taken that time. Please choose another; we've kept everything else.
errors.name_too_long: Please keep your name under 80 characters.
errors.phone_required: Add a phone number so the atelier can reach you.
errors.phone_invalid: That number doesn't look complete. Include the country code, e.g. +91.
errors.email_required: Add your email for the confirmation.
errors.email_invalid: That email doesn't look quite right. Check for a missing @ or dot.
errors.needed_by_too_soon: That's sooner than most pieces can be made. We'll talk it through at your consultation.
errors.budget_required: Choose a range, or "I'd rather discuss it".
errors.consent_required: We need your agreement to share the brief with the atelier.
errors.look_board_empty: Your look board is empty. Save at least one piece to book.
errors.submit_failed: Your request didn't reach the atelier. Nothing is lost; try again in a moment.
errors.summary_heading: A few details need a look

confirmation.title: Your consultation is booked.
confirmation.brief_line: Your design brief is on its way to the atelier.
confirmation.visit_video: Video call · the link is in your confirmation email
confirmation.email_sent: A confirmation is on its way to {{email}}.

next_steps.one: The atelier reads your brief and prepares your pieces, usually within a day.
next_steps.two: The day before, we'll send a reminder with everything you need.
next_steps.three: At the consultation, we'll settle sizes, stones and weight, and confirm a price.
next_steps.four: Nothing is made until you say yes.

confirmation.change_or_cancel: Need to change the time? Reply to your confirmation email.

look_board.title: Nothing saved yet
look_board.body: Save a piece, or take a snapshot while trying on, and it will wait for you here.

no_consultations.title: No consultations yet
no_consultations.body: When a client books, their brief will arrive here with their looks and changes.

no_results.title: Nothing matches just now
no_results.body: Try fewer filters, or another collection.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Your look board is safe on this device. We'll pick up where you left off when you're back.

camera_blocked.title: The camera is turned off for this page
camera_blocked.body: To try pieces on, allow camera access for this site.

how_to.ios_safari: On iPhone: tap aA in the address bar, then Website settings, then Camera: Allow.
how_to.android_chrome: On Android: tap the lock beside the address, then Permissions, then Camera: Allow.
how_to.desktop: On a computer: click the camera or lock icon in the address bar and choose Allow.

device_too_slow.title: Try-on needs a little more from this device
device_too_slow.body: We'll show the piece in 3D instead, turned and lit as it would be on you.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Check your connection. Your look board is safe on this device.

access_code_expired.title: This viewing has closed
access_code_expired.body: Your access code has expired. Ask the atelier for a new one.

not_found.title: This piece has wandered off the tray.
not_found.body: It may have been moved or retired. The rest of the collection is where you left it.

generic.title: Something went wrong on our side
generic.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, the atelier is a message away.

model_failed.title: The 3D view didn't load
model_failed.body: The photos and details are all here.

passcode.subline: Enter your passcode to open the dashboard.
passcode.label: Passcode
passcode.error_wrong: That passcode isn't right. Try again.
passcode.error_locked: Locked for {{minutes}} minutes after several tries.
passcode.remember_device: Keep me signed in on this device for 12 hours

brief.snapshots_none: The client kept their snapshots on their device.
